newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Oats stake held by Southeastern.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Oats stake held by Southeastern.

text.p: A group led by Southeastern Asset Management Inc said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Tuesday it holds a 7.3 percent stake in Quaker Oats Co or 9,939,106 common shares.
Southeastern, a Memphis, Tenn.,-based investment adviser, disclosed its latest position on Quaker Oats in a 13G filing.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
Quaker Oats, based in Chicago, Ill., manufactures and sells grocery products, including cereals, snacks, mixes, syrups, frozen breakfast products, dog and cat food and beverages.
